kind: in-memory ELF loader prototype on the API 26 emulator

loader.mechanism: embedded aarch64 ET_EXEC (write syscall; ret) -> write to ./probe.elf in the app workspace -> parse phdrs -> mmap(PROT_READ|WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON|MAP_FIXED, vaddr=0x400000) -> memmove -> mprotect(PROT_READ|EXEC) -> CFUNCTYPE jump to entry
